title: CPB@PLH NPs accelerate wound healing by antibacterial and anti-inflammatory effects
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11633-11646
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09475E, Paper

Yilong Li, Aidi Tong, Pengxiang Xu, Li Chang, Jialong Fan, Zhoubing Shan, Chunyi Tong, Bin Liu
CPB@PLH NPs treat diabetic wounds: PLH provides antibacterial activity; CPB NPs provide ROS scavenging & anti-inflammatory effects. In MRSA-infected wounds, they accelerate healing via collagen deposition, angiogenesis, and cytokine modulation.
